0.$description: Pure white: the top of the light elevation ladder (sheets in light mode).

100.$description: True black (OLED off-pixel): the dark-mode base surface. A hardware decision, not a colour one.

neutral.$description: Beatham warm greys (Figma: Color/Neutral). Higher number = darker. 10–90 are Jeremiah’s values verbatim; 0 (white) and 100 (true black, for OLED) are the ramp ends. Every other ramp is lightness-matched to these steps, so the step-gap rule holds: 40 / 50 / 60 apart ⇒ ≥ 3 / 4.5 / 7:1.

brand.$description: Beatham amber → brown (Figma: Color/Brand), verbatim — Jeremiah’s original values, never silently replaced. brand/50 #FFBA04 is the hero amber. The default accent ramp: amber marks only what you act on (selection, focus, the active control). Not lightness-matched (10–50 sit within 0.14 L, then 0.15 L steps), so its pairs are checked one by one; the balanced dark end is the generated brown ramp.
